h1: I Turn Messy Books Into Numbers You Can Trust.
lead: Books months behind. Payouts that won't reconcile. Reports nobody quite believes. I clean up and run the books for eCommerce brands and growing businesses, then build the budgets, cash flow forecasts and dashboards founders use to run the business.

about.heading: Clean Books First. Then the Numbers That Run the Business.
paragraphs: I'm a Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 7+ years of experience in bookkeeping, month-end close, financial reporting and virtual CFO work for eCommerce, D2C, retail and service businesses. I'm known for turning messy books into clean, audit-ready ledgers.

I'm an Engagement Lead at Renocrew Solutions. I also work with clients on Upwork, where I'm Top Rated Plus with a 100% Job Success Score. Earlier, as a Senior Manager at Verve Advisory, I led a team of 25 accountants and was virtual CFO to D2C and retail brands.
about.note: Based in Mumbai, India · Working remotely with clients worldwide

Led a team of 25 accountants. Virtual CFO for D2C and retail brands; re-engineered AR and AP for an 80% efficiency gain and oversaw Zoho to QuickBooks migrations.

faqs.q: Which accounting software do you work in?
faqs.a: QuickBooks Online (ProAdvisor since 2022), Xero (certified in 2024), Oracle NetSuite, Sage Intacct and Zoho Books, as well as Odoo, AppFolio and Yardi. I connect them to A2X, MyWorks, Bill.com and Dext, and build reporting in Excel, Power Query, Google Sheets and Looker Studio.

faqs.q: Do you work with Shopify and Amazon sellers?
faqs.a: Yes, eCommerce is my main focus. I bring Amazon, Shopify and TikTok Shop sales in through A2X and MyWorks, and reconcile Stripe, PayPal, Square, Klarna, Afterpay, Adyen and Payoneer payouts to the bank.

faqs.q: Can you catch up or clean up books that are months behind?
faqs.a: Yes. Catch-up bookkeeping and cleanups are a large part of my work, and I migrate clients between QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho and NetSuite with zero data loss.

faqs.q: What does your virtual CFO support include?
faqs.a: Budgets, 13-week cash flow forecasts, financial models, monthly MIS packs and KPI dashboards tracking revenue, gross margin, ad ROI and contribution profitability, plus cost reviews. For past clients, cost restructuring and vendor negotiations cut operating costs by 20 to 30%.

faqs.q: Where are you based, and do you work remotely?
faqs.a: I'm based in Mumbai, India (IST, UTC+5:30) and work remotely with clients worldwide, over video calls and inside your own accounting systems.
Book a free call from this page and walk me through your books and what isn't working. We'll agree on the next step on the call.
